title: Padelford Riverboats

services.name: Picnic Cruise
services.desc: Looking for something different to do on a Tuesday or Friday evening? Imagine cruising on the Mississippi River in a riverboat taking in the beautiful scenery, gentle breeze, and watching the sun set across the Minnesota sky. As the golden hour light reflects off the water, the entire experience becomes a peaceful and memorable escape from your usual routine. This relaxing evening on the river offers the perfect balance of sightseeing and dining in a unique setting. Whether you are planning a date night, a small gathering, or simply want to enjoy the beauty of the Twin Cities from the water, this sunset cruise delivers an unforgettable experience. DF = Dairy Free VG = Vegetarian VN = Vegan
